messages:
izzy: Quick Monday poll — if Slack reactions were limited to one emoji for a day, which would you pick and why?
rachel: :thinking_face: because it covers everything from thinking to oops to 'this is fine'. Versatile.
tom: :100: loud and clear endorsement. also makes every thread feel win-y.
priya: :heart: for empathy, but it gets used for everything so would be boring. still pick it.
izzy: vote time — react with :one: for :thinking_face:, :two: for :100:, :three: for :heart:
// votes
rachel: :one:
tom: :two:
priya: :three: (but would secretly use it for approvals)
lunchbot: heads up — team lunch at 12:30 in the kitchen! :sandwich: 
izzy: ok the vibes say :thinking_face:. giphy-bot for celebratory gif?
giphy-bot: [gif: tiny confetti explosion over a laptop] 
priya: follow-up: would you rather only be allowed to DM gifs for a day or only be allowed to post threads made of stickers?
tom: gifs in DMs. faster to communicate 'yasss' with a clip.
rachel: stickers in threads — chaotic but memorable.
izzy: love the mental image. thanks team, monday morale improved.
